answer.reason: Kadmiel is shown in two events: standing with Jeshua to set forward the temple workmen, and standing with the Levites to call the people to bless the LORD.

clauses.english: stood with Jeshua and his sons to set forward the workmen on the house of God
clauses.quote: Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God

clauses.english: called with the Levites on the people to stand up and bless the LORD
clauses.quote: Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever

doubts: EZR 2:40, NEH 7:43, NEH 10:9, NEH 12:8 and NEH 12:24 only list him among the Levites or name his son, so they were left out.
